description: Welcome to Islanders Restaurant & Bar, a hidden gem located on the picturesque Dauphin Island, Alabama. This delightful establishment combines the essence of New American cuisine with Southern charm, delivering a fresh take on seafood and southern-style dishes. The restaurant takes pride in its extensive selection of vegetarian options, ensuring that both meat-lovers and plant-based diners can find something to savor. The ambiance is casual and inviting, making it the perfect spot for lunch or dinner, whether you're dining solo or with a group.
